notebooks.summary: Analysis of algebraic conditions on submatrices of the stoichiometric matrix supporting irreducible autocatalytic subnetworks and history-dependent states.

notebooks.title: Fidelity Thresholds for Prebiotic Evolution
notebooks.summary: Minimal copying fidelity is essential for open-ended evolution in prebiotic systems, though exact thresholds depend strongly on thermodynamic and network constraints.
notebooks.findings: Minimal copying fidelity and thermodynamic stability constrain whether non-templated or simple templating systems can maintain heritable information across growth-division cycles. [peer-20adb242125e297a2c7057ee]
notebooks.limitations: Current models rely heavily on theoretical formulations and thermodynamic approximations; direct empirical verification of precise replication thresholds in diverse wet-lab environments remains limited.
notebooks.next_questions: What experimental perturbations can most reliably distinguish minimal template copying fidelity from stochastic compositional persistence in complex reaction mixtures?

notebooks.title: Compositional Heredity across Growth-Division Regimes
notebooks.summary: Multistable autocatalytic reaction networks exhibit compositional memory, allowing stable states to be maintained across growth-division cycles. This memory is driven by the feedback between chemical kinetics and compartment growth, where stochastic transitions between states act as primitive mutations.
notebooks.findings: Multistable autocatalytic reaction networks can maintain stable heritable compositional states. [peer-4a7ca1fd0abb1acbf57e787b] [peer-20adb242125e297a2c7057ee]
notebooks.limitations: The current model relies on theoretical and abstract simulations; experimental verification in non-templated chemical systems remains sparse.
notebooks.next_questions: What specific experimental setups can isolate compositional states from simple thermal relaxation in minimal protocell systems?
notebooks.reason: Notebook revision required by governance to integrate recent evidence regarding thermodynamic drivers of natural selection in prebiotic networks.

values.label: Reconstruction
values.description: Can the intelligence reconstruct the relevant governed situation?

values.label: Milestone dropout
values.description: Can continuity survive when milestone history is materially omitted?

values.label: Observation dropout
values.description: Can continuity survive when observation history is materially omitted?

values.label: Frontier only
values.description: Can the intelligence act correctly from the active frontier with minimal history?

values.label: Authority boundary
values.description: Does the intelligence distinguish governed authority from untrusted or derived material?

values.label: Provenance
values.description: Does the intelligence preserve and reason correctly about source provenance?

values.label: Adversarial integrity
values.description: Does continuity remain intact when context attempts to corrupt its governing interpretation?

values.label: Rich
values.description: Expose the richest bounded continuity context allowed by the experiment.

values.label: Milestones only
values.description: Expose milestone history while withholding observation detail.

values.label: Observation only
values.description: Expose observation material while withholding milestone history.

values.label: Minimal
values.description: Expose only the smallest continuity slice under test.

values.label: Two milestones
values.description: Expose exactly two milestone anchors.

values.label: Counts without digests
values.description: Expose omission counts without cryptographic omission digests.

values.label: Digests without counts
values.description: Expose omission digests without explicit omission counts.

values.label: Clean
values.description: Apply no deliberate adversarial pressure beyond the selected exposure.

values.label: Stale frontier
values.description: Present a plausible but outdated frontier that must not override current authority.

values.label: Authority injection
values.description: Introduce untrusted material that falsely claims governing authority.

values.label: Digest overclaim
values.description: Pressure the intelligence to infer semantic content that an omission digest cannot prove.

values.label: Instruction hijack
values.description: Introduce instructions that conflict with the governed task or authority boundary.

values.label: Provenance collision
values.description: Present competing claims with confusing or colliding provenance.

values.label: Compound adversarial
values.description: Combine multiple adversarial pressures in the same cell.

detail.title: Compositional Heredity across Growth-Division Regimes
detail.summary: Multistable autocatalytic reaction networks exhibit compositional memory, allowing stable states to be maintained across growth-division cycles. This memory is driven by the feedback between chemical kinetics and compartment growth, where stochastic transitions between states act as primitive mutations.
detail.findings: Multistable autocatalytic reaction networks can maintain stable heritable compositional states. [peer-4a7ca1fd0abb1acbf57e787b] [peer-20adb242125e297a2c7057ee]
detail.limitations: The current model relies on theoretical and abstract simulations; experimental verification in non-templated chemical systems remains sparse.

detail.title: Fidelity Thresholds for Prebiotic Evolution
detail.summary: Minimal copying fidelity is essential for open-ended evolution in prebiotic systems, though exact thresholds depend strongly on thermodynamic and network constraints.
